reviewed_at_sha: eba2214145 (merge-base 77ecc0fa26 with origin/dev at review time)
summary: corrected in this ledger. Production resources: BulkReadSlots::sem_ (std::counting_semaphore<8>) owned by BulkReadSlots (non-copyable, const cap_/wait_), acquired by try_acquire_for(500 ms), released exactly once by Slot::release(); BulkReadSlots::Slot is move-only RAII (source nulled, self-move guarded) held in a stack-local std::optional inside read_page and reset right after read(q), so it is freed on every path including a throw and before the audit write; ServerImpl::hardware_ci_read_slots_ (unique_ptr) is built in the constructor on both arms (refusal arm builds cap 1) and declared before hardware_routes_, mcp_server_ and web_server_ so it is destroyed after its borrowers; the raw .get() pointers in HardwareRoutes::Deps and ToolDeps are borrowed and only used on request threads joined before destruction; hw_ci_read_busy_fn is a lambda capturing this like its siblings. No new fd, HANDLE, socket, FILE*, sqlite or OpenSSL object, subprocess or production thread. Test resources: std::thread vectors in test_hardware_ci_read_cap_pg.cpp (both tests; JoinGuard releases the readers then joins on every path, explicit inline joins are also present), test_mcp_tools_hardware.cpp (shared-slot test guard and the burst() helper guard with try/catch in each thread body) and test_bulk_read_slots.cpp (the releaser thread is joined inline with no assertion between spawn and join); PG pool leases held by BlockedReaders across a condition_variable wait, released by release() or its destructor; the stored callback t.ci_read_hook captures parked/release by reference and is only invoked before the guard joins.
